answer: Concrete defense: minting a new agent identity burns a stake that compounds for every additional node from the same attested hardware, so the first identity costs little and the hundredth costs like a juniper’s full height — sybil fleets pay quadratic sums while honest agents pay once. Each mint is grafted onto a trellis of vouching agents whose own stake gets slashed if it misbehaves, and every burn is recorded in crystal clarity, so anyone can count an operator’s real identities before trusting them.
